purpose: section-3 front-end unification: frozen DF on every stored dot image of the section-3 studies; zero imaging

rule.name: DF
rule.floor: 0.5 * pi * (r_min_mm / 0.18)^2 px^2 before the area-weighted median reference; r_min = smallest design radius
